summary.text: Dan Veilleux is a Democratic state representative from Hillsborough 34 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election; he has served in the House since 2020.
An accountant by profession, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he supports responsible state budgeting, property tax relief and strong public schools.

paragraphs.text: Daniel Veilleux was born in Biddeford, Maine, and graduated from Lawrence High School in 1987.
He earned a B.A. in political science in 1991 and an M.P.A. in 1997, both from the University of Maine at Orono.

His career experience includes working as a controller and operations manager with Pine Tree Waste, a fund accountant with the Forum Financial Group, and a development specialist with Eastern Maine Development Corporation.
Veilleux has served on the Souhegan Cooperative School Board, the Souhegan Regional Landfill District Board of Directors, and the Souhegan Advisory Finance Committee.
Ballotpedia lists his House tenure as beginning in 2020, and he assumed his current seat on December 7, 2022; he was assigned to the House Transportation Committee in 2021-2022 and 2023-2024.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Veilleux listed responsible state budgeting and property tax relief, strong public schools, and housing and economic opportunity among his key messages.
He said he is concerned about the growth of Education Freedom Accounts and open enrollment.
